key_insight: The paper introduces TUM-Uteria, a paired uterine whole-slide image and pathology report dataset designed to enable multimodal computational pathology and report generation.
clinical_relevance: By linking slides with clinically meaningful reports, the dataset could help train AI tools that support uterine pathology workflow and diagnostic interpretation.
method: Collected uterine pathology cases from a tertiary medical center.
Built 216 clinical cases with 455 slide-level WSI-report pairs.
Validated annotations through a multi-stage review by board-certified pathologists.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a dataset of 216 cases and 455 paired slide-level image-report examples, with structured pathology validation rather than model performance metrics.
watch_item: As a single-center dataset, generalizability to other institutions, scanners, and reporting styles may be limited.
paper_title: Paired Uterine Whole-Slide Images and Pathology Reports for Multimodal Computational Pathology
